title: CRTFE-HCM v1.1.0: Dorian Phase Relation Reproducibility and Transferability Release
description: Versioned reproducibility archive for CRTFE-HCM carrier-level transferability and near-luminal mathematical analysis. Contains code, exact 48-C/48-L topology, frozen environment, frozen fixed-K protocol and split, complete raw Floquet sidebands, expected outputs, mandatory controls, the known invalid varying-K/fixed-fm path, and a one-command reproduction workflow. Numerical/theoretical only; no hardware-performance claim.
